# The Neural Architecture of Truth and Deception: appendix {.page-title}

[Verification notes · 30 October 2026]{.kicker}

Checked against `Exios66/truth-deception-architecture` `b7dcffb` (30 January 2025) on 30 October 2026.

## Where the exam numbers come from

The public repository does not contain the per-session exam CSVs these results were computed from. The only CSV found on main is a 50-row topic-assignment table, not the exam file. The numbers on the case study are from private analysis files and should not be read as something a reader can recompute from the linked repo.

## Pilot versus the design document

The design document plans 40 participants and five conditions, including a GPT-4o control, and does not list Enigma as a condition. Milgrim is Authority-Based there, not helpful. The case study reports the nine-person pilot assignment that was actually run. Persona profile versions are not pinned. GSR sensors are in the design-doc equipment list and are named in the withheld-data note.

Physiology, EEG, eye-tracking, GSR and workload data stay unpublished. Bug lists stay unpublished.

:::
